summary: All five pass-1 fix_tasks are correctly applied: verify-and-abort wal/shm, epoch-collision guard, real busy-checkpoint test, two-sided NFR-03 assertion, five new scenario tests.
notes: quorum analyze contract-check: ok=true, violations=[], not_checked=[forbid.behaviors]. 15 files changed (cap 17), +1619/-19 (cap 2300), all per_class globs within budget.

quorum analyze acceptance-coverage: status=issues_found with a single high gap on AC-11 (adr-0006 deliverable). Confirmed as the known blueprint annotation artifact: adr-0006-epocas-y-conmutacion-atomica.md exists, is complete, and is referenced from docs/adr/README.md with the 'Vigente' row. Not a real omission.

FIX 1 (verify-and-abort wal/shm): sellar_y_consolidar_staging drops the connection (promocion.rs:232) BEFORE checking ruta_wal.exists()/ruta_shm.exists() (lines 243-252), matching the contract's required order (checkpoint verified, connection dropped, then verify companions, then rename). Aborts with the new ErrorDeAlmacen::CompanieroDeStagingSobreviviente instead of deleting. Its test (verificar_fix_wal_shm_sobreviviente_aborta_sin_borrar_ni_renombrar) simulates the anomaly honestly by holding an external reader connection open on staging, which keeps SQLite's -shm mapping alive independent of the promotion's own successful TRUNCATE -- a realistic 'a reader this layer didn't know about' scenario, not a contrived file plant. Asserts staging still exists and no epoch file was created; does not merely assume it.

FIX 2 (epoch-collision guard): reasignar_enlace_de_la_epoca_viva checks ruta_epoca.exists() before any rename and aborts with EpocaDestinoYaExiste{numero_de_epoca, ruta}. Test verificar_fix_colision_de_epoca_destino_aborta_sin_sobrescribir plants a sentinel-content file at the destination and asserts both that the error carries the right number/path AND that the sentinel file's bytes are unchanged after the aborted attempt (fs::read equality), plus that staging still exists. TOCTOU reasoning between the existence check and the rename is not spelled out in a comment, but is evident from the codebase: reasignar_enlace_de_la_epoca_viva is only ever reached through promover_epoca, which is serialized per-instance by the AtomicBool RAII gate (iniciar_promocion/GuardianDePromocion in pools.rs), and nothing else in this codebase writes knowledge_epoch_N.db files. Minor: worth a one-line comment referencing the gate, but not a functional gap.

FIX 3 (busy-checkpoint test): verificar_ac2_punto_de_control_incompleto_aborta_sin_renombrar now opens a second connection, issues BEGIN, prepares a SELECT and calls filas.next() to genuinely step and hold a row -- this is real SQLite semantics: a live read snapshot pins the WAL and prevents a TRUNCATE checkpoint from fully draining/truncating it, so the abort branch now has real coverage. Asserts Abortada{PuntoDeControlIncompleto} with the counters, asserts staging still exists and knowledge_epoch_1.db was NOT created, then drops the blocking connection/statement/rows and asserts a retry immediately succeeds with numero_de_epoca==1 and the epoch file created. All four requested properties (real block, abort, negatives, clean retry) are present.

FIX 4 (NFR-03 two-sided): production code binds the liveness read as `cuenta` (no longer `let _cuenta`) and runs `debug_assert_eq!` against the named CONTEO_ESPERADO_DE_METADATOS_DE_CONOCIMIENTO constant inside the measured window; duracion_ms substitutes f64::INFINITY (not 0.0) on a non-finite reading, correctly surfacing rather than hiding an anomaly. The test (verificar_ac7_ac8_ac9...) independently re-reads through the swapped-in pool and asserts count==0, is_finite(), and <10.0 ms together, so the assertion cannot pass vacuously. Note: debug_assert! compiles out under the release profile, so the production-side check is test/debug-only; the meaningful two-sided proof lives in the test itself, which is what forbid.behaviors actually requires.

FIX 5 (five missing blueprint scenarios): all five now exist as real tests with substantive assertions, not restatements -- verificar_lector_previo_a_la_conmutacion_sigue_sirviendo_el_inodo_viejo (opens a reader before a second promotion, asserts it still sees the old epoch's data by value after the switch), verificar_ningun_enlace_temporal_sobrevive_en_el_directorio_de_datos (directory scan for the .knowledge_live.tmp. prefix after two promotions), verificar_medio_sellado_es_rechazado_por_el_check_de_metadatos_de_epoca (both half-seal UPDATEs independently rejected by the CHECK, row asserted to remain NULL/NULL), verificar_abrir_gestor_sobre_enlace_ya_existente_reporta_ambas_sondas_sanas (reopen over an existing symlink, both vitalidad() probes asserted Sana), and verificar_ac10_interrupcion_tras_enlace_simbolico_y_antes_del_swap_de_pool (manually replays steps 1-4, asserts the original gestor's pointer is untouched and a freshly reopened gestor follows the new symlink correctly).

New error variants CompanieroDeStagingSobreviviente and EpocaDestinoYaExiste carry didactic WHY doc comments in Spanish, Display messages are Spanish and operator-actionable (name the exact surviving file / colliding path), and source() correctly returns None for both (no underlying io::Error to wrap).

Only promocion.rs, error.rs, and tests/promocion.rs carry the incremental fix content; pools.rs, lib.rs and the docs files (STATUS.md, adr-0006, adr/README.md, bitacora) match what pass 1 already verified correct and were not altered by this fix pass.

No pre-existing test was weakened or deleted: tests/promocion.rs shows 0 deletions against main (784 insertions only); forbidden test files (tests/pools.rs, tests/migraciones.rs, tests/validacion.rs, tests/conocimiento.rs, tests/respaldo.rs) are at zero diff per contract-check.
Language invariant holds: all new identifiers, comments and error messages are Spanish; SQL keywords (UPDATE, SELECT, CHECK, BEGIN) in string literals/prose are not English leaks.
